F1: The user-storage branch serializes and persists the raw generated codes, while the credential model stores hashes.
F2: The federated validator accepts any listed code without removing it, allowing successful codes to be replayed.
F3: When user storage accepts regenerated codes, the helper skips local credential creation and leaves any prior local credential intact.
F4: Exhaustion of a federated credential triggers removal by ID through the local store, while the federated model has no ID.
F5: The package dependency cycle is an architectural concern, not a behavior defect.
F6: getCredentials` dereferences a potentially missing user and catches deserialization errors by returning no credential.
F7: The finding identifies missing test coverage, not a behavior defect in the changed code.
